Added atomic non-blocking state protection with fail-closed contention semantics; atomic lichen_duty_cycle_try_record_tx admission so concurrent callers cannot oversubscribe; chronological monotonic-time tracking that rejects regression/u64 wrap; strict zero/invalid/capacity handling; saturating interval math; partial/full rolling-window expiry; and corrected next-availability calculation to expire from TX end rather than start. Raw record_tx remains available for completed-transmission accounting, while try_record_tx is the regulatory admission entry point.
